summary: Executed targeted backend + admin UI regression testing for order-line fulfillment self-heal paths and the reported ORD-2D512BF5 issue; all requested checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: _ensure_order_line_fulfillment(order) is wired on GET /api/orders/{oid}, PATCH /api/orders/{oid}/items/{line_id}/fulfillment, and GET /api/portal/orders; targeted tests verified both response-level and Mongo persistence-level repair.
Normal POST /api/orders continues to create each line with non-empty line_id and default fulfillment_status='pending' in API response and persisted Mongo document.

For reported order id=2691093f-43bc-47d6-a218-e88744629ca5 (ORD-2D512BF5), all 11 lines persisted valid line_id + fulfillment_status and admin line-0 Processing/Shipped/Delivered controls are enabled.
seed_data_creation: Temporary multi-line orders and portal account created during tests; cleaned up from MongoDB and stock restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Targeted regression file added at /app/backend/tests/test_order_line_fulfillment_targeted.py. It validates real reported order metadata, GET self-heal persistence, portal/orders self-heal, PATCH line fulfillment after repair, and POST /orders line metadata defaults.
rca of the issue: Original failure occurred when an order was inserted outside normal checkout and line_id/fulfillment_status were absent, causing OrderDetail to intentionally short-circuit line fulfillment clicks. Current implementation repairs missing metadata on read/patch/portal-orders and persists back to Mongo, which removes the UI disablement condition.
